verdict.rationale: Plausible offers scheduled email/Slack reports (subscribing to dashboards) and explicit 'traffic spike notifications' for abnormal metric alerts, which directly maps to the story's core ask. However, evidence only covers traffic spikes/drops, not customizable alerts on other key metrics (e.g., conversions, goals, revenue) or configurable thresholds. Missing for 10: alerting on metrics beyond traffic spikes, customizable thresholds/rules, and independent hands-on confirmation that alerts work reliably in practice.
